description.en: Minimalist, dark-mode first React component library installable via CLI.
description.zh: 专为暗色模式打造的极简主义 React 组件库，支持 CLI 一键导入。

content.en: unlumen UI is a dark-mode first, minimalist component collection created for developers crafting focused developer tooling and terminal-adjacent web dashboards. It offers precision spacing, muted grays, and razor-sharp borders installable via a dedicated CLI.
content.zh: unlumen UI 是一套优先面向纯深色与低照度环境打造的极简主义 React 组件库。专门针对开发者工具、云控制台与终端风格中后台设计，它采用了克制的暗灰渐变阶梯与极细的高精度边框，为专业级软件赋予专注内敛的技术气息。
